# nemau_volume (Resource)

A block volume, in GiB.

`size` changes in place, but a volume can only grow. The plan refuses a smaller size, because the API cannot shrink a volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_volume" "data" {
  name = "data"
  size = 100
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Volume name. Changes in place.
- `size` (Number) Size in GiB. Can be increased in place, never reduced.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description. Changes in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Volume id.
- `status` (String) Status as reported by the platform.

## Import

```shell
# A volume imports by its id.
terraform import nemau_volume.data 7a2e9c4b-5d1f-4b83-a6e7-0f3c8d2b9e41
```
